mapper.sql: id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_session (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_session WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
